name: Zhi Yu Zhe: Zhui Yue Zhi Zhao
source:
An era of "peace" just liberated from the powerful ruling of The Church, A doomsday prophecy of "the fall of the moon", A struggle and intrigue around the "last Saint". "Archenemy: Lunafall" is a romantic and suspenseful visual novel, which will tell a story about "self" and...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497250/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一個剛剛擺脫教會強權統治的「和平」時代，一則關於「月亮墜落」的末日預言，一場圍繞「最後的聖女」展開的爭鬥與陰謀。《執諭者：墜月之兆》是一部融合浪漫與懸疑的視覺小說，將講述一個關於「自我」與……的故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497250/]Steam[/url]]
